title: KU Debate teams excel at Kentucky tournaments
summary_en: Multiple University of Kansas Debate teams placed in the top five at a pair of tournaments hosted by the University of Kentucky this past week.
title_cn: KU Debate teams excel at Kentucky tournaments

title: KU achieves record-high enrollment for third straight year
summary_en: The University of Kansas has achieved its highest overall enrollment in history for the third straight year, according to annual data released Sept. 30.
title_cn: KU achieves record-high enrollment for third straight year

title: Spencer Research Library to showcase historic Kiowa artwork
summary_en: Nearly a century ago, a group of Kiowa artists gained international attention for an artistic vision that challenged convention and offered a distinctly Kiowa perspective. Kenneth Spencer Research Library is featuring the “Kiowa Indian Art” portfolio in a new exhibit, “Cáuigù Gù:t,” which debuts Oct. 10. Visitors can learn more about the collection and hear from the curator.
title_cn: Spencer Research Library to showcase historic Kiowa artwork
